major.name: Frozen fast
major.card: Restrained, feet frozen to the ground

offensive.name: Shatterpoint
offensive.description: Cold does not break things. It waits for them to become breakable.

tiers.text: The damage becomes Cognitive Cold and gains 1 additional die. Against a creature carrying any Frost Stack it gains 2 more — the cold was already inside.
tiers.card: +1 die · damage becomes Cognitive Cold · 2 more dice vs anything holding a Frost Stack

tiers.text: Cognitive Cold damage increases by 2 additional dice. A creature with 2 or more Frost Stacks has vulnerability to this damage.
tiers.card: +2 dice · vulnerability to this damage at 2+ Frost Stacks

tiers.text: Cognitive Cold damage increases by 3 additional dice. Against a creature that is Restrained, Frozen, or Paralyzed, this effect deals maximum damage.
tiers.card: +3 dice · maximum damage vs Restrained, Frozen or Paralyzed

tiers.text: Cognitive Cold damage increases by 4 additional dice. A creature reduced to 0 hit points shatters — it cannot be revived by anything short of Greater Restoration, and every creature within 10 feet takes 4d10 cold damage from the burst.
tiers.card: +4 dice · drops to 0 = shatters (no revival short of Greater Restoration) + 4d10 cold in 10 ft

tiers.text: Suspend a dying creature (at 0 HP but not dead) in magical ice. They do not make death saving throws until the ice thaws at the end of your next turn.
tiers.card: Suspend a dying creature in ice — no death saves until it thaws end of your next turn

tiers.text: Use this effect as a reaction when a creature drops to 0 HP — encasing them for up to 1 minute. They are stable and cannot be targeted while frozen.
tiers.card: Reaction when a creature hits 0 HP: encase 1 min, stable and untargetable

tiers.text: A willing creature may be frozen in time for up to 1 hour. While encased they are immune to all effects but also cannot act, speak, or be detected by magical means.
tiers.card: Willing creature in stasis up to 1 hr — immune to everything, can't act or be found

tiers.text: Once per long rest, cast this effect on yourself — while frozen you are invulnerable and regain 1d4 hit dice per hour spent in stasis. You may set a condition to thaw automatically (a specific sound, time elapsed, or touch from a named creature).
tiers.card: 1/long rest on yourself: invulnerable, regain 1d4 hit dice per hour, set your own thaw trigger

tiers.text: Gain resistance to cold damage for 1 minute. While active, your Concentration cannot be broken by cold damage.
tiers.card: Cold resistance 1 min · cold can't break your Concentration

tiers.text: Once per long rest, when you are hit by cold damage, you may instead gain temporary HP equal to the damage that would have been dealt.
tiers.card: 1/long rest: turn incoming cold damage into that much temp HP

tiers.text: You gain immunity to the Frightened condition and cannot be Charmed while standing on ice or frozen terrain.
tiers.card: Immune to Frightened · can't be Charmed while on ice or frozen ground

tiers.text: When reduced to 0 HP, you may instead shatter into ice — becoming a frozen statue immune to all damage for 1 minute, then reforming at half HP as the frost around you reconstitutes your body.
tiers.card: At 0 HP shatter instead — immune to all damage 1 min, reform at half HP

control.name: Glacial Grasp
control.description: Your frost clings with oppressive force.

tiers.text: When you deal cold damage, the target's movement speed is reduced by 10 feet until the end of your next turn.
tiers.card: Your cold damage cuts speed by 10 ft until end of your next turn

tiers.text: On a failed Constitution save, the target becomes Restrained by ice until the end of their next turn.
tiers.card: Fail: Restrained by ice until end of their next turn

tiers.text: The target must succeed on a Strength saving throw to break free, or the Restraint persists until the end of your next turn (maximum 1 minute of Concentration).
tiers.card: Str save {DC} to break out, or Restrained holds until end of your next turn (conc., max 1 min)

tiers.text: The ice spreads — one additional creature of your choice within 10 feet of the original target must also save or be Restrained by the same creeping frost.
tiers.card: Ice spreads — one more creature within 10 ft saves or is Restrained too

control.name: Permafrost Curse
control.description: Chill the soul as well as the body.

tiers.text: If a creature fails a saving throw against your effect, they cannot regain hit points until the end of your next turn.
tiers.card: Fail: no healing until end of your next turn

tiers.text: The cursed creature also suffers disadvantage on Dexterity saving throws and Constitution saving throws for 1 minute.
tiers.card: Also disadvantage on Dex and Con saves for 1 min

penalty.disadvantage: Dexterity saving throws and Constitution saving th

tiers.text: Creatures that fail are vulnerable to cold damage for 1 minute. Repeat Constitution save at end of each turn to end early.
tiers.card: Vulnerable to cold 1 min · Con save {DC} at end of each turn to end it

tiers.text: Mark a creature with Cursed Ice — if they die while marked, they shatter into frozen fragments and cannot be revived by any means short of Wish or divine intervention.
tiers.card: Cursed Ice: die while marked and they shatter — no revival short of Wish or divine

creation.name: Glacial Creation
creation.description: What you shape from cold, cold keeps.

tiers.text: Your creations are slick ice. Creatures crossing a Structure treat it as difficult terrain; a creature that touches or strikes one takes 1d6 cold damage. Objects deal +1d6 cold on a hit.
tiers.card: Creations are slick ice · difficult terrain to cross · 1d6 cold to touch or strike · Objects +1d6 cold

tiers.text: Your creations are immune to cold and resistant to bludgeoning damage. A creature that starts its turn touching a Structure gains 1 Frost Stack.
tiers.card: Immune to cold, resistant to bludgeoning · 1 Frost Stack to start a turn touching a Structure

tiers.text: Structures grant three-quarters cover. A Construct's attacks apply 2 Frost Stacks, and it may Freeze a creature it grapples.
tiers.card: Structures give ¾ cover · Construct attacks apply 2 Frost Stacks and can Freeze what it grapples

tiers.text: Glacial permanence: your creations ignore fire effects of 5th level or lower, and a destroyed Structure or Construct shatters for 6d10 cold damage in a 20-foot radius (Constitution save for half), leaving Frozen Ground for 1 minute. In a region of perpetual cold, a Construct may instead be an Icebound Denizen, a native elemental of that region.
tiers.card: Ignores fire ≤5th · destroyed creation shatters 6d10 cold in 20 ft (Con half) + Frozen Ground 1 min

utility.name: Rime Whisper
utility.description: Cold is patient. It waits, and it remembers.

tiers.text: Freeze up to a 10-foot cube of water; chill or preserve food for a day; raise steps or handholds of ice on a surface you touch.
tiers.card: Freeze a 10-ft cube of water · preserve food a day · raise ice steps or handholds

tiers.text: Walk on water by freezing it beneath your feet; shape a lens of clear ice that lets you see 300 feet as if 30.
tiers.card: Walk on water by freezing it · shape an ice lens to see 300 ft as if 30

tiers.text: Place a willing creature in cryo-stasis for up to 8 hours — no aging, no bleeding, no progress of poison or disease.
tiers.card: Cryo-stasis a willing creature up to 8 hrs — no aging, bleeding, poison or disease

tiers.text: Freeze a moment: capture a scene you can see in a pane of ice that replays it once when broken, or entomb a nonmagical object so that it cannot decay, rust, or be opened without countering.
tiers.card: Capture a scene in ice that replays once when broken · entomb an object against all decay

complementEffects.name: Deep Freeze
complementEffects.description: Cold doesn't kill in an instant — it builds.

effect.text: On a hit or failed saving throw against the primary effect, the target gains 1 Frost Stack. At 2 Frost Stacks their movement speed is reduced by 15 feet. At 3 Frost Stacks they are Restrained until they succeed on a Constitution saving throw (DC equals your Verum DC) or receive fire damage. Frost Stacks fade after 1 minute without additional cold exposure.
effect.card: 1 Frost Stack · 2 = −15 ft speed · 3 = Restrained (Con save {DC} or fire to end)

upgrades.text: Level 5+: Each application of Deep Freeze now applies 2 Frost Stacks instead of 1.
Level 11+: At 3 Frost Stacks the target is Paralyzed rather than Restrained, and stacks persist for the full duration of the encounter.
upgrades.card: At 3 Stacks: Paralyzed instead of Restrained · stacks last all encounter

complementEffects.name: Frost Veil
complementEffects.description: A thin shell of ice forms between you and the world's heat.

effect.text: When the primary effect resolves, each of its targets gains temporary hit points equal to your Verum Modifier + your Proficiency Bonus. While these temporary hit points remain, it has resistance to fire damage.
effect.card: The seal's targets: {VM} + {PB} temp HP · resistance to fire while it holds

upgrades.text: Level 5+: The temporary hit points become Twice your Verum Modifier + your Proficiency Bonus, and each target also has resistance to cold damage.
upgrades.card: Temp HP 2×VM + {PB} · resistance to cold too

upgrades.text: Level 11+: While the temporary hit points persist, each target is immune to being set on fire and to environmental heat.
upgrades.card: Immune to burning and environmental heat while it holds

effect.text: When the primary effect hits or a target fails their saving throw, the ground in a 10-foot radius around them flash-freezes — becoming difficult terrain until the end of your next turn. Creatures in the area must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw against your Verum DC or be knocked prone.
effect.card: Ground freezes 10 ft — difficult terrain · Dex save or knocked prone

upgrades.text: Level 5+: The frozen terrain persists for 1 minute, and creatures that enter it for the first time on a turn must make the Dexterity save or be knocked prone.
upgrades.card: Terrain lasts 1 min · first entry each turn repeats the save

upgrades.text: Level 11+: The radius increases to 20 feet, and creatures that are knocked prone are also Restrained until they succeed on a Strength check against your Verum DC.
upgrades.card: Radius 20 ft · those knocked prone are also Restrained (Str check to free)
